responsibility: Defines the builtin-function inventory for GCC’s sanitizer support, serving as the table that declares ASan, HWASan-related ASan forms, TSan, UBSan, and sanitizer-coverage runtime entry points with their symbolic IDs, external names, function types, and attributes. This file is not a pass implementation; it is the canonical builtin-definition list consumed by GCC’s builtin machinery so front ends and sanitizer passes can refer to stable builtin enums and signatures.
